user.title: Connect to your Balboa spa

data_description.name: Device name (also entity prefix, e.g. 'Spa Pump 1'). Keep it short.
data_description.host: The spa WiFi module IP, e.g. 192.168.1.100

user.description: One quick connection test (~15s), then setup completes. If your spa's Wi-Fi module is currently asleep, the integration will still be added — it will keep retrying in the background and additional entities (pumps, lights, filter times) will appear the first time it connects successfully.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open a TCP connection to the spa.
error.no_spa_data: TCP connected but the spa sent no data (zombie socket / module fault).

rename.title: Rename this spa
rename.description: Sets the device name and the prefix on every entity's friendly name. Does not affect entity_ids or automations.

data.stale_after: Declare link dead after silence of (s)
data.reconnect_on_error: Automatically reconnect when connection is lost

data_description.connect_timeout: How long one TCP attempt may take before it is abandoned.
data_description.backoff_initial: Wait this long after the first failure.
data_description.backoff_max: Retry delay never grows beyond this.
data_description.backoff_factor: Each failure multiplies the delay by this factor.
data_description.heartbeat_interval: How often the link is health-checked while connected.
data_description.stale_after: The spa streams status ~1/s; silence beyond this means a zombie link.
data_description.max_retries: After this many consecutive failures the spa is paused.
data_description.auto_pause_after_failures: Pause automatically after repeated failures (0 disables).
data_description.stable_for: binary_sensor.spa_reachable turns on only after the link has been healthy this long — gate automations on it.
data_description.uptime_window: Window for the rolling 'Uptime' % sensor (e.g. 3600 = last hour). Charted by HA long-term statistics.
data_description.reconnect_on_error: Turn off to pause instead of retrying when the link drops.
